columns.name: job_commitment
columns.description: Tag for job position work type (e.g. Full-time, Part-time, Internship).

columns.name: job_location
columns.description: Tag for job position location.

columns.name: job_team
columns.description: Tag for the team to which the job posting belongs (a sub-category of department).

columns.name: content_description
columns.description: Job posting description that is shown at the top of the job's page, as plaintext.

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: Timestamp of when the posting was created in Lever.

columns.name: creator_user_id
columns.description: Foreign key referencing the id of the USER who created the job posting.

columns.name: posting_id
columns.description: Unique ID of the job posting.

columns.name: owner_user_id
columns.description: Foreign key referencing the id of the USER who owns the posting. The posting owner is the individual who is directly responsible for managing all candidates who are applied to that role.

columns.name: current_state
columns.description: Current status of the posting, which may include 'published', 'internal' (called 'unlisted' in the UI), 'closed', 'draft', 'pending' (awaiting approval), and 'rejected'.

columns.name: job_title
columns.description: Title of the job posting role.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.description: Timestamp of when the posting was last updated.

columns.name: count_referred_applications
columns.description: Count of how many applications were referred to this posting. Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: count_posting_applications
columns.description: Count of how many applications were submitted through the posting. Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: count_manual_user_applications
columns.description: Count of how many applications have been manually submitted by internal users. Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: count_opportunities
columns.description: Count of how many opportunities applied to this posting. Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: count_open_opportunities
columns.description: Count of how many currently open opprtunities applied to this posting. "currently open" means the opportunity's application to this posting has not been archived. Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: count_interviews
columns.description: Count of the number of interviews conducted for this posting. Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: count_interviewees
columns.description: Count of opportunities interviewed for this posting. Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: count_requisitions
columns.description: Number of requisitions associated with this posting. Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: has_requisition
columns.description: Boolean that is true if the posting has a requisition.

columns.name: is_backfill
columns.description: Boolean that is true if the requisition represents a backfill or new headcount. If unspecified, defaults to false.

columns.name: compensation_band_currency
columns.description: The ISO currency code associated with the requisition's compensation band.

columns.name: compensation_band_interval
columns.description: The string representing the interval of payment for the compensation band.

columns.name: compensation_band_max
columns.description: The high bound for the compensation band.

columns.name: compensation_band_min
columns.description: The low bound for the compensation band.

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: Timestamp of when the requisition was first created.

columns.name: creator_user_id
columns.description: Foreign key referencing the USER who created the requisition.

columns.name: employment_status
columns.description: The work type of the requisition ('full-time', 'part-time', 'intern', 'contractor', or 'temp-worker').

columns.name: headcount_hired
columns.description: The number of filled seats / openings on the requisition, or the string, 'unlimited'.

columns.name: headcount_total_allotted
columns.description: Total headcount allotted for this requisition.

columns.name: hiring_manager_user_id
columns.description: Foreign key referencing the USER who is the hiring manager for this requisition.

columns.name: requisition_id
columns.description: Unique id of the requisition.

columns.name: internal_notes
columns.description: Free form text for notes and meta-data about the requisition, visible to anyone who can see the requisition in Lever.

columns.name: job_location
columns.description: The location associated with the requisition.

columns.name: job_title
columns.description: The human-readable name for the requisition.

columns.name: owner_user_id
columns.description: Foreign key referencing the USER who owns the requisition.

columns.name: requisition_code
columns.description: The unique HRIS requisition code.

columns.name: status
columns.description: The status of the requisition. Can be 'open', 'onHold', 'closed', or 'draft'.

columns.name: job_team
columns.description: The team associated with the requisition

columns.name: count_postings
columns.description: Number of postings associated with this requisition. Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: has_posting
columns.description: Boolean that is true if the requisition has a posting.

columns.name: count_offers
columns.description: Total count of extended offers associated with this requisition. Note - includes offers regardless of their status. Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: has_offer
columns.description: Boolean that is true if the requisition has any offer associated with it.
